kids.name: title
kids.chars: 17 §1.5 · Decision journey — arming a rule (E35-D01, heuristic)

kids.name: sub
kids.chars: This journey comes from E35-D01's heuristic evaluation (docs/design/research/e35-rule-arming-trust.md §6) and assumes that report's recommended defaults (§1a). Its scores are designer judgement (DJ: a journey needs one), not measurements; the owner-run sessions of docs/design/research/e35-d01-session-protocol.md will replace them.

kids.name: journey-title
kids.chars: Owner and Manager: deciding to arm a rule (predicted scores)

kids.name: task-1
kids.chars: Wants BE after 1R to run by itself, fears a wrong order

kids.name: task-1
kids.chars: Starts from a template, reads its plain-language summary

kids.name: task-1
kids.chars: Runs it on recorded history, sees behaviour, not profit

kids.name: task-2
kids.chars: Waits for the arming gate - 5 simulated fires or 24 h

kids.name: task-1
kids.chars: Orders two rules that move the same stop (SCR-086)

kids.name: task-2
kids.chars: Reads in SCR-085 what it will do, on what, and its evidence

kids.name: task-3
kids.chars: Reads what stops the rule and what still protects the position

kids.name: task-1
kids.chars: Chooses how much it may do by itself - asks first or dry run

kids.name: task-2
kids.chars: Arms on DEMO - one confirm, no typed word, no step-up

kids.name: task-3
kids.chars: Arms on LIVE from R4 - one no-grace step-up bound to the arm, password, TOTP and a typed LIVE (SCR-006)

kids.name: task-4
kids.chars: Waits - Arming… until the server confirms

kids.name: task-1
kids.chars: Rule fires and tightens the stop - Armed · DEMO and Disarm in view

kids.name: task-1
kids.chars: Window closed - the rule keeps running on the server

kids.name: task-2
kids.chars: Bybit link lost - rules paused, resume by themselves

kids.name: task-3
kids.chars: Feed stale - still armed, skips each check and says why

kids.name: task-4
kids.chars: Engine down - not evaluating, stop-loss at Bybit unaffected

kids.name: task-5
kids.chars: Server down or its host PC asleep - rules do nothing, stop-loss at Bybit stays

kids.name: task-6
kids.chars: Server back - rules start again once positions are checked with Bybit

kids.chars: Environment first, DEMO preselected; then restatement, Will act on (CA-14), evidence (CA-15), the estimate and order lines (CA-12, CA-13), the first check (CA-38), asking first and dry runs (CA-36, CA-37), what stops it (CA-8–CA-11)

kids.name: c3
kids.chars: DEMO preselected; LIVE, disabled with a reason for a Manager: live_enablement, a no-grace step-up bound to the arm request (SCR-006 frame no-grace-live-enable, as E09-D06 draws it for live enablement: password + TOTP + a typed "LIVE"; challenge 5 min, grant 60 s), at most one open challenge per session (a newer one supersedes it); Enter on SCR-085's radios never arms; "Arming…" until rules confirms; any drop of the held arm says nothing was sent (CA-17, CA-18, CA-35)
